'''Flashpoint''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="KotOR8" /> that was located within the [[Flashpoint system/Legends|Flashpoint system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region as a part of the [[Meerian sector/Legends|Meerian sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The star was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] at a very short distance by a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was also called [[Flashpoint (planet)|Flashpoint]].<ref name="KotOR8" />
